caption:
No CRM yet? Start with a CSV file.

This n8n workflow answers the enquiry, then builds one tidy row (name, contact, category, AI summary, status) and appends it to leads.csv. It opens in Excel or Numbers, costs nothing, and you can move to a CRM later without changing the rest of the flow.

Real n8n run on a demo clinic site. The AI answer is simulated and labelled; the file write and email are real (demo inbox).
